components.css: .ds-brand-header { min-height: 59px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px 10px; background: #fffdfc; border-block-end: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #1d2645 7%, transparent); color: #1d2645; font-family: Heebo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-brand-header__spacer { width: 44px; flex: 0 0 44px; } .ds-brand-lockup { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-brand-lockup__logo { width: 34px; height: 28px; object-fit: contain; } .ds-brand-lockup__name { overflow: hidden; color: #1d2645; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em; text-overflow: ellipsis; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-recommendation { min-height: 194px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.22fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e5dfdf; border-radius: 16px; background: #fcfaf9; color: #1d2645; font-family: Heebo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-recommendation__copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 19px 15px 17px 12px; } .ds-recommendation__label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: #c51f73; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-recommendation__label svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-recommendation h1 { margin: 15px 0 0; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -.025em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-recommendation p { margin: 10px 0 0; color: #39405a; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-recommendation__action { margin-block-start: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #c51f73; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-recommendation__action svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-recommendation__visual { position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 194px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-recommendation__visual::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-block: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; width: 24px; background: linear-gradient(to left, #fcfaf9, transparent); pointer-events: none; } .ds-recommendation__visual img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 31% center; } @media (max-width: 350px) { .ds-recommendation { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-recommendation__visual { order: -1; min-height: 138px; } .ds-recommendation__copy { min-height: 205px; } }

components.css: .ds-tool { position: relative; min-height: 177px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr; justify-items: center; align-content: start; gap: 7px; padding: 14px 9px 27px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fbf8f7; color: #1d2645; text-align: center; font-family: Heebo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-tool__icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; color: #35405a; } .ds-tool__icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tool__icon .ds-tool__accent { fill: #f7a9ce; stroke: #c51f73; } .ds-tool h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-tool p { margin: 0; color: #555b70; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.38; } .ds-tool__arrow { position: absolute; inset-inline-end: 9px; inset-block-end: 8px; width: 18px; height: 18px; color: #e8368f; } .ds-tool__arrow svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.css: .ds-mentor { display: grid; justify-items: center; padding-block-start: 4px; font-family: Heebo, Arial, sans-serif; color: #1d2645; } .ds-mentor__bar { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 2px solid #1d2645; border-radius: 999px; background: #fffdfc; } .ds-mentor__field { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #e7e3e9; border-radius: 999px; background: #f7f6f8; color: #1d2645; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; } .ds-mentor__round { position: relative; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1.5px solid #1d2645; border-radius: 999px; background: #fffdfc; color: #1d2645; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mentor__round svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-mentor__divider { flex: none; width: 1px; align-self: stretch; margin-inline: 2px; background: #e7e3e9; } .ds-mentor__live { position: absolute; inset-block-start: -6px; inset-inline-end: -8px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e5322b; color: #fff; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-mentor__round:hover { background: #fffdfc; } .ds-mentor__round:active { background: #fffdfc; } .ds-mentor__round:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #e8368f 64%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Minene Cockpit feels like a capable partner who has prepared the manager's desk before she arrives: personal without becoming chatty clutter, polished without becoming corporate, and supportive without hiding direct access to the work. The shipped world uses a calm editorial reading order, warm near-white layers, navy Hebrew hierarchy, and a deliberately scarce pink accent to turn attention into one useful next step.

The interface is feminine, human, and managerial rather than decorative. Lifestyle photography supplies real-world context; precise line icons, quiet surfaces, and generous breathing room keep the experience operational. The approved home establishes the expression: welcome the manager, make one recommendation legible, organize the practical catalog, then keep the mentor composer within reach.
keyCharacteristics: Hebrew-first RTL hierarchy with one clear focus at a time.
Warm near-white surfaces grounded by Minene navy and selective pink.
Lifestyle photography paired with restrained, consistent line icons.
Airy page rhythm with dense choices grouped into calm, legible regions.
Tonal separation and hairline borders, with elevation reserved for the outer shell.

rules.name: The Pink Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Pink identifies Minene, current state, or a meaningful action; it is never scattered as decoration across every component.

rules.name: The Near-White Layer Rule
rules.body: Warm Surface, Feature Surface, Tool Surface, and Field Surface may separate adjacent regions, but their differences stay subtle enough that the product still reads as one prepared workspace.

rules.name: The Hebrew First Rule
rules.body: Type scale, wrapping, alignment, icon direction, and line length are resolved in Hebrew RTL first; LTR assumptions never define the composition.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use Heebo's weight and controlled scale to create authority; do not add a second display face merely to manufacture personality.

rules.name: The Bounded Workspace Rule
rules.body: Desktop space frames the mobile management product; it does not stretch touch-oriented controls across the browser.

rules.name: The Useful Step First Rule
rules.body: On guided entry surfaces, reveal the prepared recommendation before the complete catalog while keeping direct tool access in the same scroll.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: If a border, tonal shift, or clipped photograph already explains hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Soft, Not Toy-Like Rule
rules.body: Rounded geometry should feel welcoming and controlled; avoid bubbly proportions, excessive pills, or thick cartoon outlines outside compact controls.

dos: Do lead Hebrew RTL layouts with a single legible management priority, then keep practical alternatives close.
Do preserve the official Minene logo, Heebo hierarchy, navy authority, warm near-whites, and restrained pink action cues.
Do use real or properly licensed lifestyle photography with a thoughtful, credible management context.
Do keep line-icon stroke, optical size, rounded joins, and pink-accent behavior consistent across a set.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, visible focus treatment, safe-area behavior, and narrow-screen reflow.
Do make recommendation, personalization, unavailable-action, and mentor states honest about their real data and capability.
donts: Don't flatten a guided entry surface into an undifferentiated launcher grid where every action competes equally.
Don't replace lifestyle photography with generic gradients, decorative glass, or an unrelated illustration style.
Don't turn every warm surface into a bordered, shadowed floating card.
Don't use pink as ambient decoration or let Live Red become a second brand accent.
Don't invent routes, recommendations, profile data, or working AI behavior to make a visual state appear complete.
Don't let pale text, thin icons, or compact labels fall below accessible contrast or touch-size requirements.
